constraint_review: Span 40 m; first vertical mode about 1.9 Hz: met - concept places TMD at midspan of 40 m span and all tuning calculations use 1.9 Hz with Den Hartog optimum at ~1.85 Hz. No criteria were given, so there is nothing further to review.
feedback: Concept works physically and is buildable - accept. Working principle is classic passive vertical TMD at modal antinode: pedestrians -> deck -> frame/springs/dashpots -> 500 kg secondary mass dissipates energy as heat in viscous elements. No conservation, load-path or signal-path violation. Load path deck-clamped bearers-springs-mass and parallel dashpots is continuous; passive system needs no power or control signal. Under-deck concealed mounting meets 'without changing how bridge looks from deck'. Parts - steel block, helical steel springs, viscous dashpots, rolled bearer beams, HSFG bolts, cover - are purchasable and installable with off-site prefab, tower/under-bridge platform lift, bolted clamping, transport lock and threaded/shim re-tuning, using ordinary shop/lab methods. No welding to primary structure. Arithmetic re-derived and correct: k1=(2*pi*1.9)^2*20000=2.85e6 N/m; mu=0.025; f_opt=1.9/1.025=1.854 Hz reported as 1.85 Hz; k2=500*(2*pi*1.854)^2~=67825 N/m; c2~=1090 N-s/m; sag=mg/k2=4905/67825=0.0723 m; X_rel dense=20.1 mm; total 92.4 mm; stops +/-50 mm gives margin 2.49 on stroke. Bare single-walker with c1=1910 N-s/m (zeta~0.004): X=F/(c*omega)=280/(1910*11.94)=12.3 mm, a=omega^2*X=1.75 m/s2 matches; TMD 0.103 m/s2 ratio ~17 plausible for zeta~0.4% primary. Dense scaling with N~60 (implies ~3 m width, 0.5 ped/m2) and n_eq=10.8*sqrt(zeta*N)=5.29, F=5.29*280=1480 N, bare 9.26 m/s2, TMD 0.545 m/s2 matches linear scaling. Everyday scales sane: 0.545 m/s2 ~0.056 g gentle, 1.75 m/s2 ~0.18 g uncomfortable, 9.26 m/s2 ~0.94 g clearly unacceptable bare; 500 kg ~0.064 m3 steel ~0.4 m cube vs 300-800 mm claim, ~7 body-weights, factored 12.3 kN ~17 body-weights carried by two bearers plausible; 72 mm sag = g/(2*pi*f)^2 for 1.85 Hz correct. Controlled 0.545 m/s2 meets Setra/HiVoSS minimum comfort <1.0 m/s2 but not maximum <0.5 m/s2; shortfall 0.045 m/s2 acceptable at concept stage for dense Class III conservative resonance case, still 'comfortable' vs 9.26 bare and unacceptable >2.5. Deviations noticed but immaterial: 1.85 vs 1.8537 Hz rounding, zeta 0.0956 (E54) vs 0.0933 (E23) ~2.5% formula variant, k 67600 vs 67825 similar - do not change principle; cost $1k-10k likely optimistic for dampers + night access but does not affect physics. Key claims resting on assumption/no direct source pointed out: 20000 kg modal mass is assumption (E11 calculates stiffness from it, no deck survey/source); 0.4% bare damping implicit in c1=1910 has no cited measured value though E7-E9 searched damping; deck width/area and N=60 for 0.5 ped/m2 never stated, needed for E49-E53; bearer bending/shear/deflection and bolt slip capacity not calculated beyond 4.9 kN /12.3 kN loads; under-deck clearance envelope for 92.4 mm travel + mass + cover not dimensioned in sketch; damper datasheet selection for 1090 N-s/m, 20 mm stroke, 50 mm stops not cited. Remaining needs (not blocking acceptance, for detailed design): field modal test of f, modal mass, damping to confirm tuning, sensitivity to 15-25 t and 0.3-1.0% damping, final spring/damper datasheets, detailed frame/connection design, clearance survey and maintenance plan. Meeting closed by consensus after 4 cycles with all four votes ready and no open objections indicates settled concept; no missing proposal or objection prevents acceptance.
